ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported strong consolidated financial results for Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 16% year-on-year, EBITDA up 20%, and Net Profit increasing 14%, primarily fueled by robust growth in India and the Animal Nutrition, Industrial Bio-processing, and Specialized Manufacturing segments. However, European revenue saw a 10% decline and the largest segment, Human Nutrition, remained flat year-to-date. A notable 104% quarter-on-quarter increase in finance costs, while from a low base, warrants attention.
